design_inconsistencies.issue: Six-decimal RK literals cannot support the stated 1e-12 relative closed-form tolerance. RK-1 at s=.9 differs by 7.35752325482288e-08 relative from the design formula.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Keep rounded display rows but add reproducible 17-digit oracle fixtures and assert those at 1e-12; separately assert rounded spec text at its displayed precision.

design_inconsistencies.issue: Boundary is defined as angle psi_b, but its s=0 check compares it with sin(alpha_sh). At 3 r_s the values are pi/4 versus sqrt(.5).
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Specify angles throughout: psi_b=alpha_sh, or compare sin(psi_b)=sin(alpha_sh); pin radians in headers and tests.

design_inconsistencies.issue: Strict monotonicity in chi is incompatible with a periodic boundary, and with the chi-constant s=0 circle. The same line calls bucket-only bins committed.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Replace chi monotonicity with periodic continuity/seam, expected reflection symmetries and bounded positive capture angle; require the physically justified radial trend only. Say pinned, fetched bins.

design_inconsistencies.issue: The log coefficient is measured but the stored residual still adds a unit-coefficient log term. No format stores the measured coefficient for reconstruction; a finite truncated domain alone does not prove regularisation.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Define coefficient a_bar(chi,r), store its map/metadata and subtract/re-add it consistently; measure bounded residual and interpolation accuracy as resolution changes. If the raw 4096-column fallback is selected, review its schema and accuracy budget before proceeding.

design_inconsistencies.issue: The precision rule requires one-minus-s as an input, while the listed scalar APIs (110-117) and bh_spin-only scenario interface cannot provide that independent input.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Define a validated spin input carrying s and oneMinusS (and consistency policy), or explicitly approve a narrower precision contract for scalar callers; document wrappers and table cap. Do not invent a second incompatible representation during coding.

design_inconsistencies.issue: Optional dir defaults to pro yet is refused at s=0, leaving omission ambiguous and potentially refusing every legacy gr_orbit.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Preserve the legacy no-dir s=0 intent byte-for-byte; refuse only an explicitly supplied handedness at s=0; define pro/retro/invalid-dir rules at the Kerr minor.

design_inconsistencies.issue: Rays are projected in a ZAMO tetrad, while K1.4/K1.5 (149,157) use a static hover with beta=0, ZAMO orbit speed, and static gravitational shift. A single unnamed local frame cannot satisfy all three for spin>0.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Choose one table tetrad and explicitly specify direction/velocity/frequency transformations between it, a static observer and the moving ship. Oracle-check a nonzero-spin hovering ray and both orbit senses; no shader work until the frame contract is approved.

design_inconsistencies.issue: GR14 applies infinity asymmetry 0.412112 to the same finite-radius renders as GR13, despite line 167 correctly distinguishing finite-r silhouettes.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: At r=3/5/10 compare ratio and pinch sense with the finite-r CPU boundary; assert 0.412112 on a far-row/infinity case. Retain the stated 0.005 ratio tolerance and GR13's 0.75 px budget.

design_inconsistencies.issue: The sim accepts any s<1 while tables cap at .998 and only one spin set per scenario is generated; line 157 dispatches every s>0 into a visual path.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Keep the metric domain and table domain distinct: require an exact spin/inclination/version/hash asset match before displaying Kerr. Missing/unsupported assets produce an explicit unavailable state, never a nearest-spin or Schwarzschild substitution; define that bridge/HUD state.

design_inconsistencies.issue: The risk fallback permits null spinning tides, but G4/AC-K8 (48,189) require package-valued tide fields; no nullable protocol schema or acceptance rule is specified.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Stop for a scope decision if the oracle cannot verify tides. Approve nullable schema, sentinel text and amended ACs explicitly, or keep K1.1b-d/K1.4 blocked; never count null as satisfying the current numeric AC.

design_inconsistencies.issue: The test says lambda endpoints equal alpha extrema, while alpha=-lambda for the equatorial observer (121); the sign/order matters.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Assert alpha=-lambda (and beta squared=eta on the equator), with prograde/retrograde endpoints matched to RK-14; specify numerical endpoint tolerances rather than forcing floating residual eta exactly zero.

design_inconsistencies.issue: RK4 on (u,theta) alone does not state how the outgoing azimuth/twist is recovered; turning-point sign handling and azimuth accumulation required by K1.2 channel G are unspecified.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Specify the full Carter first-integral state, including phi (and t if frequency transport needs it), observer projection and root/turning sign transitions. Test conservation, step refinement, nonzero-spin twist and analytic capture independently.

design_inconsistencies.issue: AC-K2 ends with an unpinned PATH invocation even though A is defined as the pinned binary.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Use the absolute A in every package command, including pkg info; keep publish controller-owned behind explicit Mark approval.

design_inconsistencies.issue: GR17 requires every interpolation/boundary mutant to fail GR13, but GR13 observes the capture silhouette. A deflection-only interpolation mutation can leave that silhouette unchanged.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Map boundary mutants to GR13, twist/interpolation mutants to GR15 or an explicit float-direction probe. Require every acting rule to be killed by an appropriate golden; keep GR13/15 tolerances.

design_inconsistencies.issue: The zero-spin same-input byte comparison is ambiguous: the pristine decoder rejects bh_spin, including0, as bad_params (protocol.ail568-571). New-minor explicit0 cannot equal that old reply and also start a game; line151 also lists new fields without stating their zero-spin suppression.
design_inconsistencies.proposed_fix: Freeze absent-spin legacy requests literally, including old-minor rejection of explicit bh_spin. Define the new-minor explicit0 comparison against the prior equivalent absent-spin request (with hello excepted), and explicitly omit new GR fields for s=0 so previous GR bytes remain exact. Approve that clarification before coding.
